pr.title: Keep the composer draft when a stage reconnects
pr.author: Opened by Frontend engineer

approval.note: Your approval is separate from the agent review.

copy.appearLive: Findings appear as the review runs

postSheet.title: Post 3 findings to CodeCommit
postSheet.lead: Each finding becomes a PR comment on #451, anchored to its file and line.

F1.claim: Draft key ignores the agent, so a draft can restore into another agent’s stage
F1.why: DRAFT_KEY is the same for every stage. After a host or agent switch, the next stage reads the previous agent’s text and can send it to the wrong agent.

F2.claim: Reconnect retries forever when the hub stays down
F2.why: The spec caps reconnects at 5 tries, then shows “Hub not reachable”. Here attempt grows without a limit and each retry waits longer, so the stage never reaches the failed state.

F3.claim: Drafts stay in session storage after sign-out
F3.why: Sign-out clears the session but not relay.draft.* keys. On a shared device the next person can read the last draft.

F4.claim: Retry banner announces every attempt, flooding screen readers
F4.why: role="alert" re-announces on each attempt. The shared rule is one polite status line that changes only when the state changes.

F5.claim: No test covers a reconnect while a draft is open
F5.why: web/AGENTS.md asks for a test for each new recovery path. The added tests cover save and restore, but not a socket close with unsent text.

F6.why: Name it or reuse the shared DEBOUNCE_MS so the composer and the draft save stay in step.

F7.claim: Idle copy says “Reconnecting” when nothing is retrying
F7.why: Between attempts the banner keeps the word “Reconnecting”. The spec’s idle copy is “Waiting to reconnect”.

F8.claim: Test name doesn’t say what case it covers
F8.why: “works” doesn’t say which path is tested. Name it after the behaviour: “restores the draft after a reconnect”.

F9.claim: PR description doesn’t say drafts survive an agent switch
F9.why: The behaviour change is user-visible. Add one line to the description so reviewers and release notes pick it up.

F10.claim: Fix clears the draft when the retry banner closes, before the socket is back
F10.why: The new onClose handler calls clearDraft(). Closing the banner while the socket is still reconnecting drops the text the fix was meant to keep.

chapters.title: Why drafts were lost
chapters.problem: A reconnect remounted the stage, and the composer started empty.
chapters.before: Text typed before a reconnect was gone.
chapters.after: The draft is read back from session storage on mount.
decisions: Session storage, not local storage, so drafts end with the tab.

chapters.title: Keying drafts per agent
chapters.problem: Drafts were stored under one key per stage, so two agents on the same stage overwrote each other’s text.
chapters.before: Switching from coord to ds-rly on one stage showed coord’s draft.
chapters.after: Each agent keeps its own draft on each stage.
decisions: The key is DRAFT_KEY.agentId.stageId, not a hash, so it stays readable in devtools.
Old stage-only keys are left alone; they end with the session.

chapters.title: Bounded reconnect
chapters.problem: The socket retried on every close, with no limit.
chapters.before: A hub that stayed down kept the stage retrying for good.
chapters.after: Retries back off, but there’s still no cap; the P0 finding covers it.
decisions: Backoff doubles from 1 second to 30 seconds.

chapters.title: Tests and what they prove
chapters.problem: The PR changes recovery after a reconnect, so the tests should prove a draft survives one.
chapters.before: No test opened a draft and dropped the socket.
chapters.after: The tests check the key per agent; nothing yet drops the socket with a draft open.
decisions: Unit tests only; the browser check covers the banner.

checklist.q: Tests cover the new recovery path
checklist.note: No test reconnects with a draft open (P1).

checklist.q: Drafts are kept per agent and stage
checklist.note: The key includes agentId once the P0 fix lands.

checklist.q: Reconnect stops when the hub stays down

checklist.note: Drafts are session-only, so there’s nothing to migrate.
